detail: Background recorder com.wayned.tidemark.recorder never starts: launchd exit 78 (EX_CONFIG), relaunched ~2,400 times in 5 days
error: Background recorder com.wayned.tidemark.recorder never starts: launchd exit 78 (EX_CONFIG), relaunched ~2,400 times in 5 days
fix: recorder::renew_if_rebuilt re-registers the agent at the installed app's launch when the build (version, binary size and time) differs from the one last registered (recorder.build in the data folder); the plist restarts only on failure, at most every 300 s
root_cause: macOS pins the agent's registration to the build that registered it (the code hash, as the self-signed identity has no team ID); the app registered it only when the setting was switched, so after updating from 1.4.0 the stale registration could never spawn, and KeepAlive true retried it forever

detail: D-20261011-03 - Performance becomes Recent, with a tab per measure
Background helper still never starts after re-registering: launchd spawn failed, last exit reason OS_REASON_CODESIGNING, LWCR cdhash $in [] even for a fresh SMAppService registration
error: Background helper still never starts after re-registering: launchd spawn failed, last exit reason OS_REASON_CODESIGNING, LWCR cdhash $in [] even for a fresh SMAppService registration
fix: The helper is a plain LaunchAgent the app writes to the user's LaunchAgents folder under a new label (com.wayned.tidemark.helper) and loads with launchctl bootstrap; recorder::refresh moves an old SMAppService registration and the interim plist over, and reloads the agent (bootout + bootstrap, not kickstart) when the app moves or is rebuilt
root_cause: Not a stale registration (the earlier entry j-20261011-144721-0695 had that wrong): for an app signed with a self-signed identity, Background Task Management gives an SMAppService agent an empty set of allowed code hashes, so no build can run. A plain LaunchAgent under the same label also failed, as BTM keeps a record under that label; and kickstart -k inside the 300 s ThrottleInterval holds the helper back for the rest of it
